items.exampleEn: Before the trip, they mapped the route out carefully.
items.exampleZh: 出發前，他們仔細規劃了路線。

items.exampleEn: Luckily, the risky idea panned out in the end.
items.exampleZh: 幸好，這個冒險的點子最後成功了。

items.exampleEn: Nobody knows how the story will play out.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人知道這個故事會怎麼發展。

items.exampleEn: Few believed the old factory would pull through.
items.exampleZh: 很少人相信那家老工廠能度過難關。

items.exampleEn: Cheating is a problem at the school, and the teachers are trying to root it out.
items.exampleZh: 作弊是這所學校的問題，老師們正努力根除。

items.exampleEn: Because of the rain, the festival was scaled down.
items.exampleZh: 因為下雨，節慶活動縮小了規模。

items.exampleEn: The rules are clearly set forth in the staff guide.
items.exampleZh: 規則在員工手冊裡寫得很清楚。

items.sentenceEn: The new manager wants to root out waste in the office.
items.sentenceZh: 新經理想根除辦公室裡的浪費。

items.audioEn: My plan to study in Japan didn't pan out, so I'm taking a job in Taipei instead.
items.audioZh: 我去日本念書的計畫沒有成功，所以我改在台北找了一份工作。
items.questionZh: 說話者接下來要做什麼？
options: Work in Taipei instead of studying
Study in Taipei instead of Japan

items.sentenceEn: The coach mapped out a plan for the new season.
items.sentenceZh: 教練為新球季詳細規劃了一份計畫。

items.sentenceEn: It was exciting to watch the final game play out.
items.sentenceZh: 看著決賽一步步展開，真是令人興奮。

items.stemEn: Because of the smaller budget, we had to ____ the project.
items.stemZh: 因為預算變少，我們只好縮減這個專案。

items.stemEn: The police are working hard to ____ crime in the area.
items.stemZh: 警方正努力根除這一帶的犯罪。

items.passageEn: Three years ago, our town council set forth an ambitious plan to build a science museum by the river. Architects mapped out plans for a large building with four floors. However, costs rose quickly, and the council had to scale the design down to just two floors. Some residents worried that the project would never pan out. In the end, it opened last month, and visitor numbers have been far higher than expected. Seeing how everything developed has taught local leaders an important lesson about planning. The museum now hopes to offer evening tours next year.
items.passageZh: 三年前，我們鎮議會提出了一項宏大的計畫，要在河邊蓋一座科學博物館。建築師為一棟四層樓的大型建築擬定了詳細計畫。不過成本漲得很快，議會只好把設計縮減成兩層樓。有些居民擔心這個計畫永遠不會成功。最後，博物館上個月開幕了，參觀人數遠比預期多。看著整件事的發展，地方領導人學到了關於規劃的重要一課。博物館現在希望明年開始提供夜間導覽。

options: 政府規定不能超過三層
建築師臨時改變了想法

questions.questionZh: 博物館開幕後的情況如何？
options: 參觀人數比預期多很多
因為門票太貴，幾乎沒有人去
只開放一層樓，另一層還在施工

items.promptZh: 多虧顧客的支持，這家小店撐過了最艱難的一年。
referenceEn: Thanks to its customers' support, the small shop pulled through the hardest year.
With support from its customers, the little shop pulled through its hardest year.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「撐過」（例如 pulled through the hardest year 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 survived、got through、made it through、weathered 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 pulled through、has pulled through 等）
「多虧」可寫，例如 thanks to、with support from 等

items.promptZh: 這份報告闡述了三個主要的建議。
referenceEn: This report sets forth three main suggestions.
The report sets forth three main recommendations.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「闡述」（例如 sets forth three main suggestions 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 outlines、presents、sets out、lays out、puts forward 等）
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 sets forth、set forth 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：pan out 的 glossZh 第一義是「（結果）成功」，但例句 "Let's wait and see how things pan out."（中譯「事情的結果如何」）示範的是「發展」義，沒有示範第一義。建議改用 "The plan didn't pan out." 這類成功／不成功的例句，或把 glossZh 兩義對調。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：例句改為 "Luckily, the risky idea panned out in the end."（中譯「幸好，這個冒險的點子最後成功了。」），示範第一義「（結果）成功」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：play out 的干擾項「出去玩」是字面意思，而英式（英格蘭北部）口語確實有 kids playing out＝在外面玩的用法，屬於該片語的另一個意思，建議換成無關義。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：play out 干擾項「出去玩」（英式口語字面義）換成「拖延」
